body.p: In the Office Action, claims 2 and 3 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter which the inventor or a joint inventor regards as the invention.
While Applicant does not necessarily agree, Applicant has amended claims 2 and 3 to address the identified issues. Withdrawal of the 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) rejections is respectfully requested.
Additionally, claims 1-3, 8-9 and 14-15 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 102(a)(1)/(a)(2) as being anticipated by Porte et al. (FR 2978731).

In addition, claims 4-7 and 10-13 were objected to as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but were indicated as allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims. Applicant thanks the Examiner for the indication of allowable subject matter.

Returning to the rejections, while Applicant respectfully traverses the rejections. Solely in an effort to expedite prosecution, Applicant has amended claim 1 to include the features of claim 4. In view of the indication that claim 4 would be allowable if in independent form, Applicant submits that claim 1 is in condition for allowance. Those claims that depend therefrom or refer thereto should be in condition for allowance as well.

Applicant therefore respectfully submits that all of the claims of the application should be found to be allowable and thus requests that the Examiner indicate all of the claims as allowed and pass the application to allowance.

The amendments to the claims were done merely to expedite prosecution of the present case. Applicant reserves any and all rights to pursue the subject matter of the original claims in this application, or in another application. Moreover, these amendments should not be construed as an admission or acquiescence to any rejection.

Furthermore, the fact that Applicant has only addressed certain rejections should not be considered to be acquiescence to the rejections. Rather, Applicant has presented the argument herein in an effort to expedite prosecution. Applicant reserves any and all rights to address any rejection made but not specifically addressed herein.
The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any additional fees which may be required to this application under 37 C.F.R. §§ 1.16-1.17, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 07-2069.
Should the Examiner discover there are remaining issues which may be resolved by a telephone interview, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney at (312) 987-2927.
Respectfully submitted, GREER, BURNS & CRAIN, LTD.By /PATRICK J. SMITH/
